governing_standard: ICC UCP 600 / ISBP 745 / EU CBAM Regulation 2023/956 / DGFT FTP 2023

icc_ucp_600.standard: Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits (2007 Revision)

core_fatal_checkpoints.name: Strict Compliance Standard
core_fatal_checkpoints.condition: Documents appearing on their face to be inconsistent with terms and conditions of credit.

core_fatal_checkpoints.name: 5 Banking Day Examination Period
core_fatal_checkpoints.condition: Examination must conclude within 5 banking days following day of presentation.

core_fatal_checkpoints.name: Data Consistency Across Documents
core_fatal_checkpoints.condition: Data in a document, when read in context with credit, documents, and UCP, need not be identical to, but must not conflict with, data in that document, any other stipulated document, or the credit.

core_fatal_checkpoints.name: Goods Description in Commercial Invoice
core_fatal_checkpoints.condition: Description of goods in commercial invoice must correspond strictly with that in credit; other documents may describe goods in general terms.

core_fatal_checkpoints.name: Invoice Currency Concordance
core_fatal_checkpoints.condition: Invoice must be made out in the currency of credit.

core_fatal_checkpoints.name: Transport Document Cleanliness & Shipped on Board
core_fatal_checkpoints.condition: Bill of Lading or transport doc must indicate goods have been loaded on board or shipped, without clauses declaring defective condition (clean transport document).

core_fatal_checkpoints.name: Insurance Document Underwriting Date
core_fatal_checkpoints.condition: Insurance document date must be no later than date of shipment, or indicate coverage effective from date no later than shipment.

core_fatal_checkpoints.name: Prohibition of Partial Shipments
core_fatal_checkpoints.condition: Partial shipments not permitted unless explicitly allowed in credit field 43P.

eu_cbam.regulation: Regulation (EU) 2023/956 of the European Parliament and of the Council
eu_cbam.reporting_obligation: Quarterly CBAM declaration of direct and indirect embedded emissions (tCO2e / tonne of product)
eu_cbam.carbon_default_values_rule: Default emissions applied if verified installation-specific MRV report is absent; incurs maximum punitive default levy (€80–€100/tCO2e)

dgft_ftp_2023.policy: Indian Foreign Trade Policy (FTP 2023) - Ministry of Commerce and Industry

Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products rebate credits via ICEGATE ledger

schemes_integrated.reconciliation_timeline: 9 months from export date under FEMA guidelines
